title: 日本経済新聞に桂ゆかり主任研究員の研究が掲載されました
title_en: Research by Senior Researcher Yukari Katsura featured in Nikkei newspaper
body: 日本経済新聞18面にて、桂ゆかり主任研究員のプレスリリース「新物質を見つけるための地図を機械学習で開発して公開」に関する記事が掲載されました。
body_en: An article on Senior Researcher Yukari Katsura's press release "Machine learning-developed maps for discovering new materials published" was featured on page 18 of the Nikkei newspaper.

title: グループホームページをリニューアルしました
body: 材料モデリンググループのホームページをリニューアルしました。
body_en: The Materials Modeling Group homepage has been renewed.

title: 渡邊育夢主幹研究員がScience Direct「Most prolific reviewers」に選出
title_en: Principal Researcher Ikumu Watanabe selected as Science Direct "Most prolific reviewers"
body: 渡邊育夢主幹研究員がScience Direct「The 2024 Materials & Design Most prolific reviewers」に選出されました。科学分野における知識の進展に対する貢献が評価されました。
body_en: Principal Researcher Ikumu Watanabe was selected as Science Direct "The 2024 Materials & Design Most prolific reviewers." His contributions to the advancement of knowledge in the scientific field were recognized.

title: 渡邊育夢主幹研究員の論文がWILEY「Top Viewed Article」に選出
title_en: Principal Researcher Ikumu Watanabe's paper selected as WILEY "Top Viewed Article"
body: 渡邊育夢主幹研究員の論文「Deep Learning in Mechanical Metamaterials: From Prediction and Generation to Inverse Design」がWILEY「Top Viewed Article (Advanced Materials)」に選出されました。
body_en: Principal Researcher Ikumu Watanabe's paper "Deep Learning in Mechanical Metamaterials: From Prediction and Generation to Inverse Design" was selected as WILEY "Top Viewed Article (Advanced Materials)."

title: 新物質を見つけるための地図を機械学習で開発して公開
title_en: Machine learning-developed maps for discovering new materials published
body: 桂ゆかり主任研究員：3元素の反応可能性をまとめた「元素反応性マップ」80枚から、有望な元素の組3,000種類を提案。詳しくはこちら
body_en: Senior Researcher Yukari Katsura: From 80 "element reactivity maps" summarizing the reaction possibilities of ternary elements, 3,000 promising element combinations were proposed. Learn more

title: データを隠したまま機械学習モデルを構築
title_en: Building machine learning models while keeping data hidden
body: 出村雅彦グループリーダー：6社2国研の産学データ連携で幅広い耐熱材料の長期耐久性を予測。詳しくはこちら
body_en: Group Leader Masahiko Demura: Predicting long-term durability of a wide range of heat-resistant materials through industry-academia data collaboration of 6 companies and 2 national research institutes. Learn more
